messages.author: 9ff02ee016b8a9e0
messages.subject: Re: Interact with a sqlite3 database in Shiny
parts:
You just have to have whatever database installed that you are using. Are you using Rstudio's glimmer? They already head sqlite3 installed, so I just had to upload my database file, and call the database from the path where it was saved on the server. It's quite simple. 

I guess calling a database from a different server would require something different.  

Scott
